title: FRAUD! NOT KOREAN BEAUTY PRODUCTS!
text: DO NOT SUBSCRIBE! Previously, I was pleased with this subscription box until the last two boxes. December's box didn't arrive until February and I posted a picture of January's box because it was SO unbelievable! The only Korean item in the box was a cheap vitamin serum that was included in a box three months ago. The Corsx pimple patches were also included in a previous box and 4 pouches of them can be purchased on Amazon for $10. The other items are on off brand called Beauty Treats (NOT Korean) that are purchased in bulk on Amazon. I could have purchased multiple quantities of these poor quality items for MUCH less than $35. Claiming this is a Korean beauty box and then sending Amazon brands items is called FRAUD and I have reported this subscription to Amazon as such and demanded a refund.
label: negative
